manifest.name: dsh-skill-rag
manifest.description: Configurable, optional skill discovery for DeepSeek Harness: standard catalog, local keyword search, or hybrid retrieval with Jetson, Google, OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible embedding providers.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke

readme.text:
Optional, configurable skill discovery for **DeepSeek Harness**. It keeps the
full skill library searchable without advertising every skill in every prompt,
while leaving the original `skill` loader, instructions, resources and
procedural-learning tools untouched.

Three modes:

| Mode | What it does | Embedding provider | Index |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog` | **Standard — no RAG.** Leaves DSH's stock full catalog and loader alone. | none | none |
| `keyword` | Local SQLite FTS5/BM25 search with a small selected catalog. | none | local keyword index |
| `hybrid` | Keyword + semantic retrieval through a configured embedding provider. | Jetson, Google, OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible | versioned vector generations |

New installations default to `catalog`, so installing the plugin does not
require a key, a model service or a network connection. `hybrid` is opt-in.

From a local checkout:

```bash
npm ci
npm run verify
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

From a published Git repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kosello/dsh-skill-rag
```

The package declares one bundle row (`skill-rag`) and an optional browser
client section. The browser client registers **Settings → Skill discovery**
without editing the DSH shell.

Verify composition before restarting:

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'id: skill-rag'
```

Then restart the harness through your normal service mechanism. If you are
running the agent inside that service, use an external delayed restart rather
than interrupting the active turn.

Configuration lives on the `skill-rag` row in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. The same contract is edited by the settings panel.

```yaml
- id: skill-rag
  config:
    mode: catalog
```

This does not open an index, initialize an embedding provider, register
`skill_search`, or project a selected catalog. The stock full catalog is used.

```yaml
- id: skill-rag
  config:
    mode: keyword
    coreNames: []              # user/project DSH skills are always retained

`skill_search` and the selected catalog are enabled. No embedding provider is
constructed and no embedding request is made.

readme.section: Hybrid with a local Jetson manager
readme.text:
```yaml
- id: skill-rag
  config:
    mode: hybrid
    embedding:

The Jetson adapter accepts only a loopback HTTP service root and uses its
non-fallback embedding route.

```yaml
- id: skill-rag
  config:
    mode: hybrid
    embedding:

`gemini-embedding-2` is the stable model documented by Google for text and
multimodal embeddings. Recommended output dimensions are 768, 1536 or 3072.
The adapter sends text only; no assets are uploaded.

```yaml
- id: skill-rag
  config:
    mode: hybrid
    embedding:

OpenRouter model discovery uses its **embeddings** catalog, not the chat-model
list. Model support for dimensions, input types and routing varies by model.
An explicit model is required.

```yaml
- id: skill-rag
  config:
    mode: hybrid
    embedding:

The adapter accepts an explicit endpoint and uses the OpenAI `/embeddings`
shape. Compatibility is not assumed from a product name; test the endpoint and
its dimensions before relying on it. A remote endpoint requires HTTPS and
explicit remote consent.

Configuration contains **only environment-variable names**, never key values.
Put keys in a private environment file and reference it from the service:

```bash
install -m 600 /dev/null ~/.dsh/skill-rag.env
printf 'GEMINI_API_KEY=%s\n' "$YOUR_KEY" >> ~/.dsh/skill-rag.env
mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user/deepseek-harness.service.d
printf '[Service]\nEnvironmentFile=%%h/.dsh/skill-rag.env\n' \

Restart to apply. The settings panel reports only whether the referenced
variable is present; it never displays the value and has no secret-write field.
The TypeSafe/Jev key file is unrelated and should not be reused.

The model can call:

```json
{"query":"render a short video from a photograph on my desktop", "limit":5}
```

`skill_search` returns names and routing summaries, not instructions. The model
then loads the original skill with the unchanged `skill` tool. Search and
indexing never synthesize a successful `skill` result, so read-before-write and
the self-evolve reviewer still observe real loads.

Humans can use:

```
/skill-search status
/skill-search models
/skill-search test
/skill-search preview

`reindex` refuses to start without the explicit `--confirm` step. The settings
panel performs the same sequence through an authenticated owner-only RPC; model
tools cannot change provider settings, credentials or trigger a rebuild.

- `catalog`: nothing.
- `keyword`: nothing; local SQLite only.
- `hybrid` local (Jetson/loopback): skill cards and search queries stay on the
  machine.
- `hybrid` remote: only the configured card content and search queries are
  sent. `metadata` cards contain name, description, trigger guidance and
  explicit target hints. `excerpts` also include headings and a short
  introduction. Paths and full bodies are never part of a card. Metadata can
  still be private; remote processing requires
  `privacy.allowRemoteEmbeddings: true`.

There is **no automatic local-to-cloud fallback**. If the provider fails, the
configured `onEmbeddingError` chooses labelled keyword results (default) or a
strict error. Provider errors are returned in sanitized form.

Embedding spaces are not interchangeable, even at equal dimensions. The
namespace fingerprint includes provider, endpoint, model, explicit revision,
dimensions, query/document transforms, content policy and adapter format.
Credentials, timeout and batch size do not affect the fingerprint.

A model or policy change creates a new private generation; the prior
known-good generation stays available until the replacement is complete.
Incomplete, cancelled or superseded candidates cannot become active. A key
rotation alone reuses the same vectors. Existing 0.1 Jetson caches are adopted
into a private snapshot without modifying the old file.

The index is rebuildable local state under the configured database path. It is
not a personal-memory store and does not replace Hindsight or any other memory
service. Source skill files are never modified or synchronized by this plugin.

Mode changes take effect through the runtime: `catalog` removes selective
catalog projection and the search tool; `keyword`/`hybrid` add them. Existing
sessions may retain earlier compact catalog messages in history, but no new
compact catalogs are produced in Catalog mode.

```bash
npm run check
npm test
npm run build        # server + ModuleLoader-wrapped client bundle
npm run smoke        # real filesystem -> search -> selected catalog -> stock loader

The suite covers provider fixtures, credential and redirect safety, index
generations, mode lifecycle, management RPC, commands, settings controller and
DOM panel. Live paid-provider calls are not part of the default test suite.

`tsup` must keep `removeNodeProtocol: false`: `node:sqlite` is a prefix-only
builtin and stripping `node:` creates an invalid bare import.

- Full filesystem catalog discovery still happens internally; the plugin
  reduces prompt exposure, not discovery I/O.
- Provider input limits, batch limits and pricing vary; consult each provider.
- Dimension support varies by model. Set `dimensions` deliberately.
- A remote provider sees card metadata and queries; review the disclosure.
- A later outermost middleware could still alter the final prompt.
- Malformed legacy catalog messages are left untouched.
- The browser section integrates through the installed client-slot API; a
  changed host UI contract may require a client rebuild.
